entities.name: Hakka
entities.description: A mystical raven of Kaldheim, Alrund's favored familiar, with a single glowing eye.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God with a deep connection to ravens, who serve as his messengers and spies.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker, one of the few who notice the raven on Asi's shoulder.

entities.name: Asi
entities.description: Figure on whose shoulder Kaya notices the raven sitting.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker whose Doomskar began on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: Tibalt's Doomskar, the onset of which sent Hakka traveling.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: Realm of Kaldheim Hakka travels throughout.

events.summary: Kaya notices the raven sitting on Asi's shoulder during their encounters.
events.quote: Kaya is one of the few who notice the raven sitting on Asi ’s shoulder

events.summary: After Tibalt's Doomskar begins, Hakka travels Bretagard gathering information about the dangers threatening Kaldheim.
events.quote: Hakka has traveled widely throughout Bretagard

relations.note: Alrund's favored familiar and constant companion.
relations.quote: Hakka is Alrund’s favored familiar and constant companion
